component.name: Gnomos
component.summary: Control Sonos speakers, including first-generation hardware

description.p: Gnomos is a GTK4/libadwaita client for Sonos speakers, built on top of libnoson. It targets first-generation Sonos hardware (ZP80, ZP90, ZP100, ZP120, CR100) that Sonos's own current apps no longer support.

Scroll-to-adjust volume sliders, and a round of fixes: radio search and thumbnails never loading in the Flatpak build, cover art overwhelming the Sonos speaker's own tiny HTTP server in a large grid, artist photos getting stuck once Deezer's rate limit was hit, the cover art cache needing a full re-fetch after most restarts, "Dienst verknüpfen…" being hard to find in the sidebar, and search fields in two dropdowns not filtering anything.

Per-station MPRIS control for radio, so ad breaks between song repeats no longer retrigger notifications: an optional regex filter, and a switch to opt a station out of MPRIS entirely. The library sidebar now separates local network-share content from Sonos playlists, radio and linked services, and a linked service's name is always capitalized.

A header-bar spinner for any Sonos activity, a room-info dialog that shows every device in a merged zone, a stricter (and clearer) room-grouping flow, and fixes for a missing volume slider, two popovers that forced scrolling, and a mismatched disclosure widget.
Fixed a radio station's Now Playing icon getting permanently stuck on the generic fallback, even when its thumbnail displayed correctly everywhere else.

Real thumbnails for custom radio stations added via the Radio-Browser search, shown both in the library and the Now Playing bar. The About dialog now links to the GitHub project and credits Radio Browser.

Radio station search against radio-browser.info's public directory, deleting a custom station, playlist editing (add a track, reorder tracks), line-in autoplay settings, a library rescan action, and a handful of fixes — a stale library cache hiding freshly added or deleted content, several actions shown on radio stations that didn't make sense there, and cover art flickering briefly right after launch.
Switching to a very large library grid (1000+ entries) no longer takes several seconds — cover art now decodes off the main thread.

Consistent, type-aware icons throughout the library (including linked third-party services), optional real artist photos via Deezer, a live filter for long library lists, a device info dialog per room, sub gain control, playlist deletion and custom internet radio stations, several smaller additions, a proper app icon, and a couple of fixes (empty library after visiting a service, real images displaying larger than fallback icons).

A bottom Now Playing bar with a much wider seek bar, a collapsible section sidebar (styled after noson-app) with the library's own categories listed as sub-items, a compact room picker in the header bar, a library grid/list toggle, and several layout and popover fixes.
Repeat-one, MPRIS shuffle/repeat control, suspend/resume resilience, ringing-alarm and transport-error toasts, and a cache for library browsing that fixes sluggish navigation.
"Play all"/"add all to queue" in the library, success toasts, optional track-change notifications, remembered window size, and a fix for both side panels being invisible at normal window width.
Volume/mute keyboard shortcuts, a "jump to current track" queue button, artist search from track details, and a fully collapsible Now Playing panel.
Confirmation dialogs, Settings and keyboard shortcuts rebuilt on current libadwaita widgets; the room sidebar now collapses on narrow windows; clipboard copy in the track details dialog.
Play history tab, light/dark appearance override, library entry counts, and a Space bar shortcut for play/pause.
Album/Artist cover art grid and a configurable, disk-persisted cover art cache.
Three-pane layout with a dedicated Now Playing panel, and cover art thumbnails throughout.
Fixed the "Gen 1" badge, which never appeared due to reading the wrong device property.
Add-to-queue and play-next actions, richer alarm options, destructive-action confirmations, local library search.
Fixed a false "queue could not be loaded" error and stale rows after clearing the queue.
Fixed duplicate service entries after relinking, and "remember last room" restoring the wrong room.
Support for third-party music services (Spotify, bonob and other SMAPI-based services).
Track details dialog, seek bar, queue reordering, save queue as playlist.
MPRIS2 support, sound settings, sleep timer, line-in switching.
Initial version: zone discovery, playback controls, volume, queue, favorites, alarms.
